differences.a_observable: Background cards are heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: Background cards are sharp and fully in focus.
differences.fix: Reduce the camera f-stop to achieve a shallower depth of field.

differences.a_observable: The border of the Juspay card is a highly reflective metallic silver.
differences.b_observable: The border is a flat matte grey with no metallic reflection.
differences.fix: Apply a metallic material with high specularity to the card border.

differences.a_observable: Deep shadows are visible in the crevices between the tiles, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: Crevices have very soft, light shadows, resulting in a flat look.
differences.fix: Adjust the shadow settings and key light to deepen contact shadows.

json.highest_impact_fix: Apply a metallic material with high specularity to the borders of the cards to match the reflective look of the reference.
